sql: SELECT trips.fish_date_doy, trips.cls, COUNT(*) as trips_count, ROUND(SUM(trips.yt), 0) as total_yt, ROUND(SUM(trips.anglers), 0) as total_anglers FROM trips WHERE trips.fish_date_doy >= 182 AND trips.fish_date_doy <= 213 GROUP BY trips.fish_date_doy, trips.cls ORDER BY trips.fish_date_doy, trips.cls LIMIT 100

SELECT trips.fish_date_doy, ROUND(SUM(trips.yt) / SUM(trips.anglers), 4) as fleet_yt_per_angler FROM trips WHERE trips.fish_date_doy >= 180 AND trips.fish_date_doy <= 213 GROUP BY trips.fish_date_doy ORDER BY trips.fish_date_doy LIMIT 50
